design: Additive builder build_with_graph performs the existing validated fresh build and returns its internally refreshed graph along with pack. Existing build returns the pack; no caller-supplied graph/status is accepted.
MemoryService.graph still independently refreshes then delegates its exact pure projection body. Combined graph_context re-fetches canonical project using injected UoW before choosing reuse.
Reuse requires exact built-in MemoryService type, no instance graph/context override, matching project IDs and exact canonical/project/inspected Path roots.
Subclass/instance override or differing inspected worktree is delegated to existing graph(project) then context(inspected_project), preserving canonical entity graph and inspected context semantics.

Missing or changed canonical root falls back to existing graph/context calls; missing canonical project still fails through existing context NotFoundError and changed root retains original context re-fetch/common-directory authority.

Fast path constructs the normal builder with canonical storage root, inspected source root and same injected GitService. Root/common-directory/storage guards and graph schema/parser/hash validation remain; no cache or validation bypass.
The fresh graph used to rank context is projected into Brain entities/relations within the same request. No tuple/model/status is persisted or retained across requests.
instrumentation_scope: Existing context @observed(memory.context) and body unchanged. Fast path private context helper records the same operation name/outcome and preserves budget/build/agent conversion error instrumentation.

Canonical lookup for reuse occurs outside the fast-path observed context duration; this is an explicit small span-boundary change. Fallback invokes original context exactly once without nested new context spans.
Graph entity projection remains outside the observed context operation.
limits: Proposal is unapplied; no tests/type/lint/build/browser/benchmark executed for these private files.
External filesystem/Git/canonical project mutations during a request are best-effort observations as before; no global atomic snapshot promise.

Existing build now delegates additively to build_with_graph; subclasses overriding only build retain their public override, but new combined call uses build_with_graph on a normally owned built-in builder.
Private helper accepts authoritative project objects but never externally supplied graph/status tuples; only internal same-root guard calls it.
No browser five-second cure, performance improvement, P1 closure, frozen86 acceptance or full release qualification claimed. Full rounds remain0/2.
required_validation: Same-root one refresh and exact entity/relation/context shape parity; existing context and graph public contracts remain.
Two successive requests after HEAD/branch/dirty-file changes remain fresh; no request-local data leaks.
Different inspected worktree HEAD/dirty contents preserves canonical entity graph versus inspected context with separate calls.
Unrelated workspace denial, missing run/project, project/run mismatch and linked/corrupt storage fail through original guards.
Fresh canonical project missing or root changed after initial Brain lookup takes original fallback, including differing repository denial.
MemoryService subclass and instance graph/context overrides remain invoked; custom injected UoW/Git denial and project isolation preserved.
Budget/query validation, context observed operation name/error outcome, rank freshness/task history and full dirty paths retained.
